key_findings: Review of inorganic, organic, natural and hybrid H2S donors and H2S synthesis inhibitors in CNS/PNS injury models.
H2S donors suppress oxidative stress, inflammation, pyroptosis and BBB disruption; synthesis inhibitors worsen neuroinflammation.
